firm_data.firm_description: Menken Simpson & Rozger LLP is a NYC employment law firm that provides legal services for workers in the workplace, including employment discrimination, wage theft, sexual harassment, and retaliation. They represent individual employees and groups or classes.
notable_facts: They have recovered significant judgments and settlements under statutes such as the Americans with Disabilities Act; Title VII of the Civil Rights Act; Sarbanes-Oxley Act; the Federal False Claims Act; and the Fair Labor Standards Act.
Partners Scott Simpson and Bruce Menken were named to the 2023 Lawdragon “500 Leading Civil Rights & Plaintiff Employment Lawyers in America” Guide.

email.subject: AI for Menken Simpson & Rozger LLP, built for employment law firms
email.body:
Hi Bruce,

Your firm's track record recovering significant settlements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and Title VII shows the caliber of work you do for individual employees and class groups. That precision demands tools that match your standards.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
